HuntFloor — A Self-Learning Sales Operating System

Live lead economy, AI coaching, and real-time floor intelligence for teams that work leads

HuntFloor is a self-learning sales operating system for teams that buy and work leads. Every lead carries a value and a clock; hunters choose what to pursue and build their own P&L, reputation and earning power with each sale. The system learns who converts what, when and why, then routes and coaches accordingly — call scripts, objections and drafts drawn from the lead itself. Management gets lead-source ROI, conversion patterns, talent gaps and revenue leakage in real time, with CRM discipline, attendance and settlements handled underneath. Works alongside your existing CRM, or as one for smaller teams.

Built for sales teams in India: real estate brokerages, insurance agencies, travel and venue operators, and dealerships that buy and work leads. Born at DestinMe, India's leading private estates and luxury hospitality operator. Enquire for a customised sales floor for your team.

HuntFloor turns the sales floor into a live performance economy.

Every lead has a value, every hunter chooses what to pursue, and every sale builds their own P&L, reputation and earning power. AI learns who converts what, when and why — then coaches each hunter on every opportunity. Management sees lead-source ROI, conversion patterns, talent gaps and revenue leakage in real time.

It's not gamification layered on sales. It's a self-learning sales operating system where people think like owners and the floor gets smarter with every deal.
Born on a real floor — DestinMe, India's leading private estates & luxury hospitality operator, runs its own sales on it daily. Not a demo.
